title: Darwin Operator Symmetry Atlas (DOSA) v3 U0 development contract — not a data release
description: Development-only, fail-closed contract for testing whether DOSA can serve as a reusable calibration resource for bacterial-window reversal and reverse-complement observations under a 1000-draw fixed-endpoint dinucleotide null. Sounio is the canonical scientific producer and Julia is the independent validator. Gate U0 has not passed; this repository state contains no v3 public atlas and is not eligible for deposition.
notes: DEPOSITION BLOCKED. A v3 release requires a passing real-pilot U0 receipt, full Sounio production, independent full Julia validation, payload closure, and an external-use receipt. The published v2.1.2 DOI is preserved separately and is not rewritten by this development branch.
